pretreatment: Rapidly preheated to 858 K under Zn flux to remove the oxide layer
evidence: In all of our experiments we have used 'epiready' semi-insulating GaAs (100) substrates. The wafers (1.5 in. in diameter) were 'indium free' mounted without any MO holder directly onto the process manipulator. Before the growth, the substrate was rapidly preheated to 858 K under Zn flux, to remove the oxide layer.
